lines.lyric_translation: Cause I like you
There’s no other reason, I like you

lines.lyric_hangul: 그대 웃는 모습 바라보면 난 더는 바랄 게 없어
lines.lyric_translation: When I watch you smile / There’s nothing more I could ask for
Cause I just like you

lines.lyric: Gwaenhi mutgo shipeo neoye harue daehae
lines.lyric_hangul: 괜히 묻고 싶어 너의 하루에 대해
lines.lyric_translation: I just wanna ask you about your day

lines.lyric: Neoye yaegil deunneun ge nae chwimiga dwae
lines.lyric_hangul: 너의 얘길 듣는 게 내 취미가 돼
lines.lyric_translation: Listening to your stories has become my hobby

lines.lyric: Haru jung gajang jjalpge neukkyeojineun shigan
lines.lyric_hangul: 하루 중 가장 짧게 느껴지는 시간
lines.lyric_translation: Feels like the shortest time of the day

lines.lyric: Jeonbu deutgo shipeo neoye gomine daehae
lines.lyric_hangul: 전부 듣고 싶어 너의 고민에 대해
lines.lyric_translation: I wanna listen to all your worries
Let me share your load

lines.lyric: Haru jung neoye eokkaeye muge gajang gabyeoul su itge
lines.lyric_hangul: 하루 중 너의 어깨의 무게 가장 가벼울 수 있게
lines.lyric_translation: So you can break free from the heavy burden
You’ve been carrying
You can lean on me until your cloud of worries disappear

lines.lyric: Geunshim geokjeonge angaega geochil ttaekkaji deo gidaedo dwae
lines.lyric_hangul: 근심 걱정의 안개가 걷힐 때까지 더 기대도 돼
lines.lyric_translation: From your clear eyes

lines.lyric_hangul: 왜 힘든 건지 뭐가 너를 괴롭혔는지
lines.lyric_translation: What’s giving you / Such a hard time

lines.lyric: Igeon binmari anya da daeshin himdeulgo apa jugo shipeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 이건 빈말이 아냐 다 대신 힘들고 아파 주고 싶어
lines.lyric_translation: I’m serious, I’d rather hurt instead of you
Seeing you smile makes me happy
Even though you look the prettiest when you smile

lines.lyric: Ulgo shipeul ttaen eokjiro utji ma
lines.lyric_hangul: 울고 싶을 땐 억지로 웃지 마
lines.lyric_translation: When you just wanna cry, don’t fake a smile

lines.lyric_hangul: 행복으로 가득 찬 너의 눈동자는 yeah
lines.lyric_translation: Your eyes filled with happiness yeah
are water that will spill even with the slightest jolt
That’s why I’m more cautious
I’m worried for you ’cause I like you
Cause I just like you
For no other reason, I like you

lines.lyric_hangul: 그대 웃는 모습 바라보면 난 더는 바랄 게 없어
lines.lyric_translation: When I look at you smile / There’s nothing more I could ask for
Cause I just like you

lines.lyric: Gachi itgo shipeo onjongil haru jongil
lines.lyric_hangul: 같이 있고 싶어 온종일 하루 종일
lines.lyric_translation: I wanna be with you all day
Without mood swings, full of laughter
You cried yesterday but I’m glad you feel better
The sparkling tears in your dewy eyes are diamonds
I like your honest expression
I like that you’re not good at hiding your facial expressions

lines.lyric: Geunikka sumgiji ma geuge deo himdeun geo
lines.lyric_hangul: 그니까 숨기지 마 그게 더 힘든 거
lines.lyric_translation: So don’t conceal it
You know better how much harder it is

lines.lyric: Haengbogeuro gadeuk chan neoye nundongjaneun yeah
lines.lyric_hangul: 행복으로 가득 찬 너의 눈동자는 yeah
lines.lyric_translation: Your eyes filled with happiness yeah
Are water that will spill even with the slightest jolt
That’s why I’m more cautious
I’m worried for you ’cause I like you
Cause I just like you
For no other reason, I like you

lines.lyric_hangul: 그대 웃는 모습 바라보면 난 더는 바랄 게 없어
lines.lyric_translation: When I look at you smile / There’s nothing more I could ask for
Cause I just like you
I just really love you

lines.lyric: You’re the only reason why I really love you
lines.lyric_hangul: You're the only reason why I really love you
lines.lyric_translation: You’re the only reason why I really love you

lines.lyric: When I see you smile I just can’t get enough
lines.lyric_hangul: When I see you smile I just can't get enough and
lines.lyric_translation: When I see you smile I just can’t get enough

lines.lyric: And I can’t live without you
lines.lyric_translation: and I can’t live without you
